votes.motion: Close the public hearing on RDA Budget Amendment No.3 for Fiscal Year 2023-24 and defer action to later in the RDA meeting.
votes.description: The Board closed the public hearing on Budget Amendment No.3 and postponed formal action on the resolution to a later point in the same meeting.

votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of March 19, 2024.
votes.description: The Board approved the official minutes from the RDA meeting held on March 19, 2024.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 06 of 2024 (RDA Budget Amendment No.3 for Fiscal Year 2023-24).
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution amending the RDA's final budget for FY2023-24, including reallocations related to a property acquisition in the North Temple project area among other items.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 07 of 2024 authorizing use of State Street Community Reinvestment Area funds outside of the area boundaries for Ballpark properties.
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution determining that use of State Street CRA project area funds on the Ballpark properties (approximately 77 West 1300 South and adjacent properties not within the CRA boundaries) will benefit the State Street Project Area, providing ongoing authorization for such fund use.

votes.motion: Approve the consent agenda (including setting the date of June 11, 2024 to accept public comment and consider RDA Budget Amendment No.4 for Fiscal Year 2023-24).
votes.description: The Board approved the consent agenda, which set June 11, 2024 as the date to hold a public hearing and consider adopting a resolution for RDA Budget Amendment No.4, covering adjustments based on actual property tax increment and additional funding for agency operations and the Ballpark NEXT project.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for the purposes of strategy sessions to discuss the purchase, exchange, or lease of real property, and attorney-client matters.
votes.description: The Board voted to convene a closed session to discuss real property transactions and privileged attorney-client matters.
The Board voted to conclude the closed session and return to open session.
